subject.value: Water / Waste – Waste Water Drain Line – Modification
subject.raw_text: ATA 38 Water / Waste – Waste Water Drain Line – Modification

applicability_groups.label: A340 applicability stated in the AD
applicability_groups.raw_text: Applicability: Airbus A340-541, A340-542, A340-642 and A340-643 aeroplanes, all manufacturer serial numbers.

unsafe_condition.raw_reason_text: Reason: Investigations showed that the distance between the heating element of the waste water drain line and the fuel line at fuselage frame (FR) 77/78 could be too small, which potentially induces chafing between the fuel line and the waste water heating element. This condition, if not corrected, could lead to a short circuit and consequent arcing on the fuel line, possibly resulting in a fuel leak and an uncontrolled fire. To address this unsafe condition, Airbus developed a modification to prevent chafing, which is to be embodied in service through Airbus Service Bulletin (SB) A340-38-5017. For the reasons described above, this AD requires modification of the waste water drain line, establishing a correct distance between the affected drain line and the fuel line.
observed_events_or_defects: Investigations showed that the distance between the heating element of the waste water drain line and the fuel line at fuselage frame (FR) 77/78 could be too small, which potentially induces chafing between the fuel line and the waste water heating element.
causes: Insufficient distance between the waste water drain-line heating element and the fuel line at fuselage frame 77/78.
unsafe_conditions: Potential chafing between the fuel line and the waste water heating element, with possible short circuit and arcing on the fuel line.
affected_components: Waste water drain-line heating element at fuselage frame 77/78
intended_risk_mitigation: Modify the waste water drain line to establish the correct distance from the fuel line.

requirements.action_text: Required Action(s) Required as indicated, unless accomplished previously: and Compliance Within 24 months after the effective date of this AD, modify the waste water drain Time(s): line in accordance with the instructions of Airbus SB A340-38-5017.
objects_or_components: Waste water drain line at fuselage frame 77/78
